alkylation reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide followed by protein precipitation with ice cold ethanol overnight at − 20 °C.
cleavage agent: Samples, 30 µg, were digested with trypsin overnight.
labeling: The generated peptides were injected into liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS).
reduction reagent: 100 µL was reduced with dithiotreitol and alkylated with iodoacetamide followed by protein precipitation with ice cold ethanol overnight at − 20 °C.
